title: Ethereum: $1.5B ETF inflows meet aggressive selling – Can $2.3K hold?
summary: The streak of Ethereum spot ETF inflows indicated firm demand, but derivatives data showed aggressive selling at the same time.
content: Ethereum spot exchange-traded funds recently recorded strong inflows totaling $1.5 billion, signaling firm market demand. However, corresponding derivatives data revealed aggressive selling pressure simultaneously entering the market. Analysts are closely watching whether key price support levels, specifically around the $2,300 mark, will hold amid these conflicting market forces.

title: South Korea to require mock trading before retail investors can touch leveraged ETFs
summary:
South Korea's new rules aim to curb impulsive retail trading in leveraged ETFs, promoting informed investment and reducing potential financial losses.
The post South Korea to require mock trading before retail investors can touch leveraged ETFs appeared first on Crypto Briefing.
content: South Korea has announced new regulations requiring retail investors to complete mock trading before they can access leveraged exchange-traded funds. The initiative is designed to discourage impulsive trading behavior, encourage better-informed investment strategies, and help protect everyday market participants from experiencing significant financial losses.
